# TimeStamp { #timetoalign.TimeStamp }

```python
TimeStamp(
    coordinates,
    source_id,
    source=None,
    is_interpolated=False,
    conversion_maps=True,
)
```

A synchronized instant across a timeline hierarchy.

Lightweight view object over typed coordinates.
Works identically for Timeline (with children) and TimelineGroup (with members).

The TimeStamp represents a cross-section through the timeline structure at
a specific axis coordinate. Related coordinates are retrieved through the
typed precise getters and dispatcher.

## Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes}

| Name      | Type                                                                    | Description                                              |
|-----------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------|
| axis      | [IdCoordinate](`timetoalign.core.time.IdCoordinate`)                    | The root/reference coordinate value.                     |
| source    | [TimeStampSource](`timetoalign.core.timestamp.TimeStampSource`) \| None | The Timeline or TimelineGroup this timestamp belongs to. |
| source_id | [str](`str`)                                                            | ID of the source (for serialization).                    |

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> ts = timeline.get_timestamp_at(5.0)
>>> ts.axis  # The root coordinate with identity
IdCoordinate(5.0, seconds, 'audio')
>>> ts.get_coordinate_for("child:1", format="float")
2.5
```

```python
>>> # Convert to different unit
>>> ts.get_unit(TimeUnit.seconds, format="float")
10.5
```

## Methods

| Name | Description |

### get_conversion_for { #timetoalign.TimeStamp.get_conversion_for }

```python
TimeStamp.get_conversion_for(key)
```

Get the raw output of a conversion map addressed by name/selector.

Searches the source and every descendant/member present at this axis
for a C-Map whose name, id, selector, or target-unit name is *key*, and
evaluates it at that timeline's coordinate.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type         | Description                                               | Default    |
|--------|--------------|-----------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| key    | [str](`str`) | A conversion-map name, id, selector, or target-unit name. | _required_ |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type               | Description                                            |
|--------|--------------------|--------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [object](`object`) | The C-Map's output at this instant without projection. |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                   | Description                        |
|--------|------------------------|------------------------------------|
|        | [KeyError](`KeyError`) | If no enabled map matches ``key``. |

### get_unit { #timetoalign.TimeStamp.get_unit }

```python
TimeStamp.get_unit(
    unit,
    *,
    timeline_id=None,
    format='id_coordinate',
    rounding='round',
)
```

Convert one stored coordinate through an eligible unit map.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name        | Type                                                              | Description                                | Default           |
|-------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------|-------------------|
| unit        | [TimeUnit](`timetoalign.core.enums.TimeUnit`)                     | Requested target unit.                     | _required_        |
| timeline_id | [str](`str`) \| None                                              | Optional stored axis to select explicitly. | `None`            |
| format      | [CoordinateFormat](`timetoalign.core.retrieval.CoordinateFormat`) | Requested coordinate output format.        | `'id_coordinate'` |
| rounding    | [Rounding](`timetoalign.core.retrieval.Rounding`)                 | Integral projection mode.                  | `'round'`         |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                                                                                          | Description                          |
|--------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------|
|        | [CoordinateResult](`timetoalign.core.retrieval.CoordinateResult`) \| [pd](`pandas`).[Series](`pandas.Series`) | The converted coordinate projection. |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                   | Description                                                   |
|--------|------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [KeyError](`KeyError`) | If the selected timeline is absent or no eligible map exists. |
